purpose: Review whether existing Visual, Resource and Work Observatory surfaces need refinement or expansion after S31, without adding collectors, dashboards, schemas, runtime telemetry, importers or visual features by default.

surfaces_reviewed.evidence_summary: Contracts, snapshots, static prototype and dogfood records exist; phase closeout keeps collectors, UI/backend and telemetry gated by repeated usage evidence.
Skill/tool/resource signals can be represented as source-backed metadata, but collection and runtime telemetry remain deferred.
Five work_record examples exist, but comparison-readiness review shows they are heterogeneous and not one stable comparison group.
SYSTEM_STATE and continuity contracts help first-load/restart, but source-backed documentation-health records are not yet sufficient for an Observatory health projection.

collector_or_importer.reason: No repeated manual evidence-assembly failures are documented as materially limiting the existing projector.

dashboard_or_ui.reason: Static Markdown/JSON and prototype review records exist, but no repeated review cadence proves they are insufficient.

persistent_event_store_or_backend.reason: No demonstrated cross-slice query or retention need exceeds checked-in artifacts.

runtime_token_or_cost_telemetry.reason: No authoritative provider or harness record with consent, provenance and sensitivity classification is available.

comparative_work_metrics.reason: S18 remains deferred; five work records do not share one reviewed stable comparison_group.

documentation_health_projection.reason: No source-backed documentation coherence records exist at a sufficient cadence.

decision.summary: Existing Observatory surfaces are mature enough for static read-only review and evidence accumulation, but not mature enough for collectors, dashboards, runtime telemetry, comparative metrics or automatic health inference.
decision.next_small_slice: If a future review is needed, patch wording, labels or source mapping in the existing surfaces before adding new infrastructure.

unavailable_inputs: repeated UI insufficiency in a real review cadence
